titulo: Quiz — The signs you can read are the ones that trick you
introPt: A traveller works out whether a shop is open, and when it will be.
cenario: In front of a printed sign on a shop door.

dialogo.es: Chiuso per ferie. Riapriamo il ventidue agosto.
dialogo.pt: Closed for holidays. We reopen on the twenty-second of August.

dialogo.es: Alle sedici. Ora facciamo la pausa.
dialogo.pt: At four. We're on the break now.

perguntas.pergunta: What does camera mean on an Italian sign?
perguntas.explica: A classic false friend — the ones that look safest are the expensive ones.
Fuori servizio says the same thing: find the other machine.
Written hours are almost always on the twenty-four hour clock.

opcoes: Open straight through, no afternoon break
perguntas.explica: It announces the exception, which tells you the pausa is the rule nearby.
Entrata and uscita are the in and out pair.
